description.ja: キャラクターの魅力をオリジナルアレンジで“増幅”！『遊☆戯☆王デュエルモンスターズ』より、三幻神の一体「オシリスの天空竜」がAmplifiedに降臨！！
description.en: “Amplify” the charm of the characters with original arrangements! From "Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters ", one of the three phantom gods, " The Sky Dragon of Osiris", has arrived at Amplified! !

description.ja: ■うねった体、大きな翼の再現で威厳ある存在感を表現。
description.en: • The undulating body and large wings give it a dignified presence.

description.ja: ■特徴的な二つの顎を可動させ、「超電動波サンダーフォース」をAmplified解釈で表現。
description.en: • Move the two characteristic jaws to express the "super electric wave thunder force" with an amplified interpretation.
